title: On colorful generalizations of the Goodman--Pollack transversal problem
summary: We establish a colorful and, more generally, matroidal solution to the problem of Goodman and Pollack on the existence of an $\mathbb{F}$-affine $k$-dimensional transversal to a family of convex sets in $\mathbb{F}^d$, where $0 \le k \le d - 1$ is an integer and $\mathbb{F} \in \{\mathbb{R}, \mathbb{C}\}$ is a field. Our results unify several classical and recent theorems. In the case $k=0$, we recover the colorful Helly theorem of Lovász, together with a matroidal extension due to Kalai and Meshulam.
